description:
A team workspace for running AI coding agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees, live diff review, GitHub integration, and mobile access.

Lody is a team agent workspace: share coding agents with your team on phone and desktop. Shared sessions, live diffs, and one control plane keep your team and agents in sync.
Run agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees and live diff review, use subscriptions you already have with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Kimi, and any agent that speaks ACP, manage the same control plane in the terminal with CLI commands, and ship together in one workspace with shared sessions, usage by member, and PR, CI, and merge status in-session.
Version 0.107.2
🐛 Fixes & Improvements
- Fix personal GitHub authorization failing when your GitHub and Lody email addresses differ, and improve the return to settings after authorization. Existing users need to authorize again once in GitHub settings.
- Support linking sign-in accounts with different email addresses, including accounts using Apple's Hide My Email.
- Fix Claude subagent image reads causing session data to grow excessively, leading to slow loading or failed synchronization.
- Improve MCP resource list recovery during startup, reconnection, and after synchronization errors, reducing missing resources and synchronization states that stop updating.
Thanks to external contributor demystify0137 for contributing to this release!
